response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT sites.healtheval AS status, SUM(scans.scancount) AS total_scan_count, SUM(scans.gbsize) / SUM(scans.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT status_rates.status, status_rates.total_scan_count, status_rates.rate, status_rates.rate - overall.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE status_rates.rate > overall.average_rate;
